title: A non-commutative discrete first Painlevé hierarchy: the Lax pair approach
summary: Using a non-commutative analogue of the isomonodromic problem associated with the discrete first Painlevé hierarchy, we construct a non-commutative version of this hierarchy, denoted by $\text{d-PI}_m^{\text{nc}}$. We show that both hierarchies, $\text{d-PI}_m$ and $\text{d-PI}_m^{\text{nc}}$, can be expressed in terms of the polynomials $S_s^k(n)$, which we call the Svinin polynomials.
